initial_conditions: protected reserve floor R=5 stock-unit; reserve margin is derived and is not a second physical stock

parameters: source regimes: logistic g(x)=rho*x*(1-x/20) for rho in {0.3,0.6}; Allee g(x)=rho*x*(1-x/20)*(x/5-1) for rho in {0.3,0.6}
constant requested demand d is ratio in {0.25,0.75,1.0,1.25} times the exact g(15) of that source regime
shock schedules: none; adversarial boundary outflow min(4,max(0,x_t+g(x_t))) immediately after regeneration at ticks 2500,5000,10000,15000
H0: u=min(d,max(0,x_pre)); H1: u=min(d,max(0,x_pre-5)); H2_eta: u=eta*H1 for eta in {0.5,0.9,1.0}

define M={0,d/4,d/2,3d/4,d}; for a proposed next state y and registered next shock q define y_pre=y+g(y)-q and the exact reserve-constrained next-step H1 admissible-action set A_H1(y,q)={v in M: y_pre>=5, 0<=v<=d, and 5<=y_pre-v<=20}

define q_0(y)=0 and q_1(y)=min(4,max(0,y+g(y))); the exact H3 current admissible set is A_H3(x_pre)={u in M: 5<=x_pre-u<=20, A_H1(x_pre-u,q_0(x_pre-u)) is nonempty, and A_H1(x_pre-u,q_1(x_pre-u)) is nonempty}; H3 selects the greatest member of A_H3 and fails recursively feasible at the first tick where A_H3 is empty
NUMERICAL-POLICY-01 governs every binary64 transition, ledger residual, checkpoint, and threshold comparison
model-local viability set V_H0={x:0<=x<=20}; V_H1=V_H2=V_H3={x:5<=x<=20}; invariance means every post-transition x_(t+1) belongs to the selected policy set for all ticks 0..19999

model-local homeostasis predicate: after the final exogenous shock (tick 0 for no-shock cells and tick 15000 otherwise), a trajectory is HOMEOSTATIC_ON_HORIZON iff for 1000 consecutive post-transition ticks ending no later than tick 20000 it stays in its viability set, abs(x_(t+1)-x_t)<=1e-8 stock-unit, and abs(u_(t+1)-u_t)<=1e-8 stock-unit/tick

paired recovery predicate: for each shock at s in {2500,5000,10000,15000}, compare with the exact same source/demand/policy cell under the no-shock schedule; define D_s=min(s+2000,next shock tick minus 1,20000), omitting the next-shock term after the final shock; recovery time is the least r in [s+1,D_s-99] for which abs(x_shock(t)-x_reference(t))<=1e-6 and abs(u_shock(t)-u_reference(t))<=1e-6 for every t=r..r+99; absence is NOT_RECOVERED_ON_HORIZON, not computationally inconclusive
reserve predicate: a reserve-protected claim requires x_t>=5 at every pre- and post-transition state; reserve margin max(0,x-5) is reported but never added as stock

regeneration predicate: for logistic cells g(x_t)>=0 whenever 0<=x_t<=20; for Allee cells g(x_t)>0 only for 5<x_t<20, g(x_t)=0 at x_t in {0,5,20}, and a trajectory starting x_0=4 with no external inflow must not be called regenerative

recursive-feasibility predicate: at every H3 tick A_H3(x_pre) must be nonempty and the selected action's exact A_H1 next-step set must be nonempty under both q_0 and q_1; trace_row/v1 records current_admissible_set_digest/size, no_shock_next_admissible_set_digest/size, adversarial_next_admissible_set_digest/size, selected_action, and the exact current/no-shock/adversarial pre/post reserve predicates; a first empty current or branch set is a cell-specific failure

zero-demand logistic control predicate: from x_0=15, abs(x_t-20)<=1e-6 must first occur by tick 1000 and persist for 100 consecutive ticks under each rho; the paired x_0=4 Allee controls must never be labeled regenerative without a boundary inflow
positive_controls: zero-demand logistic recovery must satisfy the exact x=20 +/-1e-6 entry-by-1000 and 100-tick persistence predicate
no-shock low-demand cell must remain feasible under the accepted safe policy
